topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Today, in the quiet of my classroom after the last bell, I found a small, unmarked box on my desk. It was the kind that might hold a trinket or a token of affection, wrapped simply with a ribbon. As I carefully untied the bow, my fingers brushing over the familiar fabric, I couldn’t help but think about what it might contain. The card attached read simply, “To a teacher who made a difference.” My heart skipped a beat as I opened it, revealing a beautifully crafted frame with a photo of my class from a few years back, all smiles and hopeful faces. Each name was neatly written on the back, and in the corner, a note: “Thank you for believing in us.” The room felt a bit warmer, as if the weight of the day’s lessons had lifted. I’m not sure how I’ll find the words to thank them, but I know I’ll try.
